user.title: Connect to Enable Banking
user.description: Register `{callback_url}` as an exact redirect URL in your Enable Banking application. The private key is stored in Home Assistant's config entry and backups.

bank.title: Choose a bank
bank.description: Choose the bank and how long access should be requested. The bank may enforce a shorter period.

authorize.title: Authorize bank access
authorize.description: Complete authorization in the opened bank page, then return here.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew bank consent
reauth_confirm.description: The bank consent expired or was revoked. Continue to authorize access again.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Enable Banking
error.invalid_auth: The application ID or private key is invalid
error.no_banks: Enable Banking returned no banks for this country

abort.access_denied: Bank authorization was cancelled or denied
abort.already_configured: This bank connection is already configured
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Enable Banking
abort.external_url_missing: Configure a public HTTPS external URL in Home Assistant first
abort.invalid_session: Enable Banking did not return a valid session
abort.invalid_state: The authorization response did not match this setup request
abort.missing_code: The bank did not return an authorization code
